concept: Toy-box bright: a joyful primary-color palette for Anderson's Toyshop. Royal-blue primary and cherry-red secondary snap against a warm off-white, sunny-yellow accent pops on dark hero panels, and friendly navy ink keeps everything legible and kid-energetic.
contrastNotes: All ratios verified WCAG-AA. ink #0E2A4A on bg #FFFDF7 = 14.25:1 (>=7). ink-soft #3A5573 on bg = 7.57:1 (>=4.5). white on primary #1551C9 = 6.88:1 (>=4.5). primary on bg = 6.76:1 (>=3). accent #FFD21E on near-black #000 = 14.49:1 (>=3) for bright pops on dark heroes. Bonus: white on primary-dark = 9.88:1, white on secondary #E11D2E = 4.75:1, ink on surface-alt = 13.14:1.
